scope: Live standalone headset installation, PC-to-Quest content installation, reviewed AI scene edits, and virtual screenshot feedback. No physical-camera pixels are included.

sciFiRequest.heardTranscript: Build a sci-fi scene and import a bunch of sci-fi stuff
sciFiRequest.originalResult: The planner named matching packs but asked the wearer to import them manually; no content was installed by that original voice request.

replayAfterFix.firstScreenshotFinding: Panorama dominated the view and obscured the lab props.
replayAfterFix.firstCorrectionAttempt: Headset disconnected before acknowledgement; four queued edits were marked unconfirmed and not counted as applied.
replayAfterFix.correctionAfterReconnect: AI proposed deleting the panorama and moving the table, chemistry set, and microscope toward the viewer. The Quest acknowledged the four edits; the scene then held 12 objects.
replayAfterFix.finalImageReview: The AI identified a recognizable sparse sci-fi lab, visible workbench, chemistry set, and microscope; it proposed no further edits. Fine detail remained uncertain because the capture was distant and the headset HUD overlapped the lower view.

modelSelection.cacheIssueReproduced: A shorter local Codex model cache temporarily omitted the configured model and rejected explicit reasoning selection.

limits: No performance or frame-rate acceptance measurement was made.
Virtual captures exclude physical passthrough and depth.
AR prefab installation, physical alignment, and mixed camera capture remain untested in this session.
Panorama domes are scene objects, not actual Unity skybox switching.
